question: Which player has the highest market value (most recent valuation on record)?
answer: Erling Haaland has the highest market value, valued at €180,000,000 as of his most recent valuation on 29 May 2025.
sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_id) player_id, market_value, date_unix
  FROM player_market_values
  ORDER BY player_id, date_unix DESC
)
SELECT p.player_name, l.market_value, to_timestamp(l.date_unix) AS valuation_date
FROM latest l
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = l.player_id
ORDER BY l.market_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

out.notes: Grain: player_market_values is a time series (player_id, date_unix in Unix SECONDS). For each player, pick the latest valuation via DISTINCT ON (player_id) ORDER BY player_id, date_unix DESC, then order overall by market_value DESC LIMIT 1. Join players(player_id) for player_name. Convert date_unix with to_timestamp(date_unix) if displaying the valuation date.
